name: Quntis Monitor Light Bar (USB, touch control)
caption:
Your desk is lit wrong, and this fixes it. 💡

It is a slim light bar that sits on top of your monitor and runs off USB. The light points at your desk, so your keyboard and notes are bright without glare on the screen.

It has touch controls and auto-dimming, and it takes no desk space at all.

Tip: angle it at the desk surface instead of toward your face.
